title: Build the vetted Apple Silicon temperature addon after safe npm installation.
changes: Keep global npm installs and agent auto-updates protected by --ignore-scripts; explicitly build only the reviewed macos-temperature-sensor@2.1.1 native addon if the installed first-party runtime pins that exact optional package and script.

Verify module paths, installed manifests and build directories before invoking the bounded, rootless node-gyp rebuild. Reject arbitrary package scripts, symlinks, unexpected versions and unsafe paths.
Support both fresh macOS installs and rollback-safe transactional updates. A missing compiler or unsupported sensor remains unavailable without disabling other ReMCP tools.
Reproduce the 0.2.199 failure on a real M1 Mac: --ignore-scripts leaves the native .node file absent. Confirm the approved build produces real CPU, SoC and GPU Celsius measurements without sudo.
Add deterministic installer, rollback, optional failure and security regression tests; retain the release-first public npm/tag verification before private merge and deployment.
